zu.title: KUMIHAN｜Hlela — Ukuhlelwa kombhalo wesiZulu
zu.description: I-KUMIHAN｜Hlela isiza ekuhleleni nasekubuyekezeni amawebhusayithi, amadokhumenti nemiklamo yesiZulu, ngaphandle kokushintsha umbhalo wangempela.
zu.lead: I-KUMIHAN｜Hlela iyisethi yamakhono e-AI avulekile yokwakha nokubuyekeza amawebhusayithi, imibiko namaphrezentheshini ngesiZulu. Ihlela umbhalo, izikhala nokulandelana kolwazi ngokomongo, ngaphandle kokushintsha okwangempela.
zu.concept_body: Umyalezo ngamunye unabafundi nenhloso ehlukile. I-KUMIHAN｜Hlela isiza ukukhetha ukuhlelwa kwamagama, izikhala nokubaluleka kolwazi ngokomongo, hhayi ukuphinda umklamo ofanayo.

features.p: Gcina izinhlamvu ezinkulu ngaphakathi kwegama elithi isiZulu, amagama amade nezakhi zamagama. Hlola izindawo zokuhlukanisa amagama ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa.
Beka ulwazi ngendlela ehambisana nomyalezo nomfundi.
Ungaguquli amagama, amanani, izinsuku nezimpawu ngaphandle kwemvume.
Hlola ukufundeka, izikhala nokwakheka ngaphandle kokushintsha amafayela.

zu.idea_body: I-KUMIHAN｜Hlela ayiphoqi isitayela esisodwa. Isiza ukukhetha umklamo ngokohlobo lombhalo, abafundi nenhloso.
zu.skills_deck: Kusukela enhlosweni kuya kuwebhu, amadokhumenti nokubuyekeza.
skills: Chaza inhloso, abafundi, ulimi nemvume yokuhlela.
zu.install_body: Khetha umhlahlandlela wethuluzi lakho bese ufaka amakhono owadingayo.
zu.status_body: Inguqulo yokuqala inemithetho engu-24, izivivinyo ezingu-20 namakhono amane. Ukuhlolwa ngabakhuluma isiZulu, ukufakwa kumathuluzi nokubukwa ezipheqululini kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa.
zu.cta_body: I-KUMIHAN｜Hlela ingumthombo ovulekile futhi imahhala. Amafayela nomlando wezinguquko ku-GitHub.
zu.footer_sub: Ukuhlelwa kombhalo wesiZulu emiklamweni esizwa i-AI.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Hlela — Natural isiZulu typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Hlela is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing isiZulu websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Hlela is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing isiZulu websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Hlela helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing isiZulu content.

features.p: Protect conjunctive words and internal capitalization. Confirm hyphenation in the real language and rendering environment.
Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal.
Preserve source words, numbers, names, case and spacing. Any proposed edit comes with a diff.
Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Hlela doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: Scope the brief, explicit isiZulu locale, source permissions, reader and media.
Typography and design for isiZulu websites, articles, landing pages, and UI.
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks.
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.
en.install_body: Setup varies by tool. Pick the guide for yours, then choose the skills you need.
install_notes: Guides for adding skills, registering plugins, and local installation
Setup guide for Claude Code and Claude chat
Setup guide for Gemini CLI and the Gemini app
en.status_body: v0.1.0 contains 24 research rules, 20 acceptance scenarios, four skills and 15 versioned archives. Native proofreading, live rendering and AI host installation remain unverified.
en.cta_body: KUMIHAN｜Hlela is open source. The skills, releases, and full change history are on GitHub.
en.footer_sub: isiZulu typography skills for AI-assisted design.

guide.note: Installation and invocation have not yet been checked in each tool. Some steps may not be available in your environment.
guide.title: Install KUMIHAN｜Hlela in {host}
guide.lead: Choose the full plugin or individual skills, depending on what your tool supports.
sections: Try it without changing the source
guide.format: The plugin contains all four skills. Each skill is also distributed on its own, with its rules and references. Attaching a ZIP to a chat does not install anything.
guide.download: Download the ZIP files from GitHub Release v0.1.0 and compare their SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt before installing.
guide.chatgpt: Use the ChatGPT / Codex plugin only through the plugin import feature your client provides. In Codex, extract each skill into the project’s .agents/skills/ directory. ChatGPT Skills upload depends on your account.
guide.claude: Extract the plugin keeping the kumihan-hlela folder, validate with claude plugin validate and use claude --plugin-dir where supported. Individual skills may be placed in .claude/skills/. Native host support must be verified.
guide.gemini: Extract the extension with gemini-extension.json under kumihan-hlela, then install from that folder with Gemini CLI. Gemini Apps use is a separate, unverified workflow.
guide.test: Specify isiZulu locale (sw-TZ, sw-KE etc.), medium, house style and edit permission. Example:
guide.prompt: Use kumihan-hlela-review to review isiZulu typography without changing the original source text.
guide.update: Save your customizations, verify the new version and its checksums, then update the way your tool supports. A new commit alone does not update an existing installation. Do not overwrite plugins for other languages.
guide.limits: 24 proposed isiZulu checks and a source-byte comparator are supplied. Browser rendering, native host registration, marketplace listing and native editorial review are not verified.

ja.title: KUMIHAN｜Hlela — ズールー語のデザインをもっと自然に
ja.description: KUMIHAN｜Hlelaは、AIによるズールー語のWebサイト・文書・プレゼン資料の制作とレビューを支援する、オープンソースのスキル集です。
ja.nav_label: メインナビゲーション
ja.lead: AIとつくるズールー語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜Hlelaは、ズールー語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜Hlelaは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜Hlelaが大切にする考え方。

features.h3: ズールー語に合う文字組み
features.p: 接辞を含む長い語や「isiZulu」の内部大文字を守り、改行は言語規範と実機の両面で確認します。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。
原稿の語形、固有名、数字、内部大文字、空白を保護します。修正は差分と承認を残します。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。

idea_h2: 文字を並べるだけでなく
読む体験を組み立てる
ja.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Hlelaは完成デザインを一律に指定しません。使う媒体や条件に合わせて考えるための知識を提供します。
ja.skills_deck: 制作の入口から、Web・資料制作・レビューまで。
skills: 対象読者、ズールー語の指定、原稿の編集権限、制作媒体を明確にします。
ズールー語のWebサイト、記事、LP、UIの文字組みとデザインを支援。
報告書、資料、プレゼンテーションの構成と読みやすさを支援。
制作物を変更せず、組版・情報・デザインの見直しを支援。
ja.install_body: 導入方法は利用環境によって異なります。お使いのツールのガイドから、必要なスキルを選んでください。
install_notes: スキルの追加・プラグイン登録・ローカル導入のガイド
Claude Code・チャット向けの導入ガイド
Gemini CLI・Geminiアプリ向けの導入ガイド
ja.status_body: 初版v0.1.0は規則24件、受入テスト20件、独立スキル4種と配布ZIP15件。母語校閲・実機表示・AIホストへの導入は未確認です。
